flow_ref: There is no OCMS flow deck; steps are taken from the story text. Sheet status: Demo paid (50% of 75%); demo_remark: SFTP, code split required, SFTP permission for the api App Service server.
code_summary: No code writes a summons posting date. The only vendor return-file parser (ToppanResponseParser) extracts only postal registration numbers for RD2/DN2, not a court summons posting date. ocmsadminui has the type Isummon.posting_date and a date_of_posting field in REPCCSDetail, but the display block is commented out and its data source repccsrecords is only enabled in STAGING/LOCAL. No code in ocmsadminapi, ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, thirdpartyapi.
note: The sheet status 'Demo paid (50% of 75%)' is a demo claim, not code evidence; the repos show no posting date being written. The SFTP connection to the partner cannot verify from repo. No maintenance ticket is specific to court summons posting date.
recommendation: No code evidence for updating or showing the summons posting date. The demo-paid status is not backed by the repos; verification outside the repos is needed before claiming.

steps.step: The court PDF file has been interfaced to the printing vendor (precondition)
steps.detail: No court file is interfaced to a vendor; the Toppan path covers only parking letter stages RD1 to ANL (ToppanStage.java:19-25) and the generator call in the scheduler is commented out (ToppanUploadJobsScheduler.java:118). Details in OCMS24.11. The SFTP connection to the partner cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: OCMS updates the summons posting date on the notices after the vendor interface
steps.detail: No code in the six repos writes posting_date or date_of_posting (grep for posting, dispatch, mailing date, postal date across all layers found only the UI type). The Toppan return-file parser extracts only the postal registration number for registered mail files RD2/DN2 (ToppanResponseParser.java:154-162, 370-395), which is not a court summons posting date. There is no summons table on the API side.

steps.step: Staff can browse the summons posting date in OCMS
steps.detail: The type Isummon has posting_date (Isummon.d.ts:12) and REPCCSDetail.tsx:227-229 has a date_of_posting TextField2, but the whole Summary block sits inside a JSX comment (REPCCSDetail.tsx:177 to 291), so it is not rendered. The active grid uses resource repccsrecords only when isAPIFound (REPCCSDetail.tsx:48; env.ts:11 = STAGING or LOCAL, not DEV/UAT/PRO) and shows REPCCS data, not summonses. The Report page 'Court Summon Reports' is only a label with no path (Report/index.tsx:70-73) and its resource in ActionReport.tsx:51-56 is commented out.
